description: Start a fresh public email-security check of one domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DANE, DNSSEC, MX and BIMI). Use this when there is no stored result yet or you need an up-to-date one; to read an existing result, call get_result instead. It returns only a queue confirmation, not the report. The response includes poll_after_ms. Wait that long, then poll get_result. A check usually takes a few seconds and is stopped after 45 seconds at most.

domain.description: Registrable domain name without scheme, path or port, for example example.com.

name: assess_domain
title: Assess Domain Email Security
